YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Safe opening & repair

Enquire about safe opening, lost safe keys or a faulty lock. Share the make and model to help the locksmith assess the next step.

Call 020 4505 8291Send an enquiry

Identify the safe

Provide the make, model and whether it uses a key, keypad or another locking method. A photo of the outside can help; do not include access codes or images of private contents.

Explain the fault

Tell us whether a key is lost, a handle will not move or a keypad is no longer responding. Avoid forcing the handle or attempting to drill the safe yourself.

Assessing access and repair

The locksmith checks what work is possible for your safe before confirming an approach. Opening and repairing a fault may be separate tasks, depending on the locking mechanism and available parts.
